title: Interface for variants of the contact process
summary: We study two one-dimensional variants of the contact process: the contact-and-barrier process, where the population evolves in a region delimited by a randomly moving barrier, and the multitype contact process, in which two species compete for space. The contact-and-barrier process is started with the barrier at the origin and all sites to its right occupied, while the multitype contact process is started from the Heaviside configuration with species 1 to the left of the origin and species 2 to the right.
